name: MatterFileRetentionManager
tagline: Close, archive, retain and securely destroy matter files – with legal holds, client notice and four-eyes approval.
description: A complete records-management app for law firms and legal departments in one PCF control: practice-area closure checklists with client account and storage checks, partner closure sign-off, archiving, retention schedules with overrides and permanent areas, legal holds that block destruction, a 12-month eligibility forecast, destruction review with client notice, four-eyes partner approval, destruction method and certificate log. Works in Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages, with demo data out of the box.
features: Retention schedule per practice area (0 = permanent) with file overrides and extensions
Closure checklist per practice area, zero client account balance, storage and boxes, original deeds and wills
Partner closure sign-off and records-officer archiving
Legal hold apply/release – blocks destruction and recalls approved files
Destruction review with client notice period and four-eyes approval
Destruction certificate log and overdue approvals
Bulk assign officer, send eligible files to review, apply hold, export CSV, undo
Phone layouts from 320 px, keyboard and ARIA support
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.MatterFileRetentionManager data-set; niray_Niray.MatterFileRetentionManagerPortal field control)
